import sys


def main():
    nets = {}
    vats = {}
    for line in sys.stdin:
        line = line.strip()
        if not line or line.startswith("#"):
            continue
        parts = [p.strip() for p in line.split(";")]
        if len(parts) != 4:
            continue
        try:
            description, quantity_str, unit_price_str, rate_str = parts
            quantity = float(quantity_str)
            unit_price = float(unit_price_str)
            rate = float(rate_str)
        except ValueError:
            continue
        if quantity <= 0:
            continue
        line_amount = round(quantity * unit_price, 2)
        nets[rate] = nets.get(rate, 0.0) + line_amount
        vat_amount = round(line_amount * rate / 100, 2)
        vats[rate] = vats.get(rate, 0.0) + vat_amount

    total = 0.0
    for rate in sorted(nets.keys()):
        net = nets[rate]
        vat = vats[rate]
        print(f"{rate}% net {net:.2f} vat {vat:.2f}")
        total += net + vat

    print(f"total {total:.2f}")
    payable = round(total * 20) / 20
    print(f"payable {payable:.2f}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
